description: Professor Oak ordered a parcel from the Poké Mart before the Cataclysm.  Pick it up from any Poké Mart clerk and bring it back to him.

dialogue.describe: My parcel from the Poké Mart.
dialogue.offer: Before you go off adventuring, could you do an old man a favor?  I ordered a parcel from the Poké Mart before everything fell apart.  If the clerk is still there, would you fetch it for me?
dialogue.accepted: Splendid!  The Poké Mart is in town.
dialogue.advice: Just ask the clerk for Professor Oak's parcel.
dialogue.success: Ah, this is the custom Poké Ball I ordered!  Thank you.  Now, I have a far bigger request…
dialogue.success_lie: That doesn't look right to me.
dialogue.failure: Don't give up.  Come back when you're ready.

description: Professor Oak wants you to register 5 different species of Pokémon in your Pokédex.  A species is registered the first time you have one of your own.

dialogue.offer: The Pokédex is incomplete without field data.  Could you register 5 different kinds of Pokémon?
dialogue.rejected: Oh, well, I'll keep at it myself.
dialogue.advice: Different Pokémon live in different places.  Forests, rivers, the sea, caves… even the sewers.
dialogue.inquire: How is the Pokédex coming along?
dialogue.success: Splendid work!  5 Pokémon!  Here, take these; you've earned them.
dialogue.success_lie: That doesn't look right to me.
dialogue.failure: Don't give up.  Come back when you're ready.

description: Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres have been sighted.  Catch all three legendary birds.  Professor Oak marked their roosts on your map.

dialogue.offer: There are reports of three legendary birds: Articuno in an icy sea cave, Zapdos at the old power plant, and Moltres in a volcanic cave.  If you could catch them… well.  I've marked where I think they are.
dialogue.accepted: Be careful!  They're far stronger than anything you've faced.
dialogue.advice: Bring Ultra Balls and Pokémon with an advantage.  Put them to sleep if you can.
dialogue.inquire: Any luck with the legendary birds?
dialogue.success: You actually did it!  All three!  History in the making.
dialogue.success_lie: That doesn't look right to me.
dialogue.failure: Don't give up.  Come back when you're ready.

description: A Pokémon created in a lab is said to hide in a sealed cave.  Find it and catch it.

dialogue.describe: A cave, and something inside it.
dialogue.offer: There is a cave that was sealed off by the League long ago.  Something terribly powerful lives in there: a Pokémon called Mewtwo, created by human hands.  Only the Champion should even attempt this.
dialogue.advice: It is psychic.  Bug and Ghost moves are your best bet, and bring every Ultra Ball you have.
dialogue.inquire: Have you been to the cave?
dialogue.success: Mewtwo… with you.  Treat it kindly.  It has known little kindness.
dialogue.success_lie: That doesn't look right to me.
dialogue.failure: Don't give up.  Come back when you're ready.

description: Challenge Brock at their gym and win the badge.  The gym is marked on your map.

dialogue.offer: Every trainer worth the name collects the eight League badges.  Your next challenge is Brock.  I've marked the gym on your map.
dialogue.advice: Gym Leaders specialize in one type.  Bring Pokémon that have the advantage.
dialogue.success: Another badge!  You're becoming a real trainer.

description: With all eight badges, travel to the Indigo Plateau and defeat the reigning Champion.

dialogue.offer: You have all eight badges!  The Pokémon League waits at the Indigo Plateau.  The Champion there… well, you'll see.  I've marked it on your map.
dialogue.accepted: Show them what you're made of!
dialogue.advice: The Champion uses a balanced team, with a Charizard as the ace.
dialogue.inquire: Have you been to the Indigo Plateau?
dialogue.success: Champion!  I knew it.  Now then, how about that Pokédex…
dialogue.success_lie: That doesn't look right to me.
dialogue.failure: Don't give up.  Come back when you're ready.

name.str: Medical supplies for the Pokémon Center

description: Nurse Joy needs 10 bandages to keep the Pokémon Center running.

dialogue.offer: We're running low on everything, but bandages most of all.  Could you bring me ten?  I'll pay you in Pokémon medicine.
dialogue.advice: Pharmacies and hospitals are dangerous, but houses often have first aid supplies.
dialogue.success: These will help so many Pokémon.  Please take these.
dialogue.success_lie: That doesn't look right to me.
dialogue.failure: Don't give up.  Come back when you're ready.

description: Nurse Joy needs antibiotics for infected Pokémon.

dialogue.offer: Some of the Pokémon brought in have infected bites from the dead.  I need antibiotics.  Five doses would save a lot of lives.
dialogue.advice: Hospitals and pharmacies, if you're brave.
dialogue.success: This is wonderful.  Here, my Chansey wants you to have these.
dialogue.success_lie: That doesn't look right to me.
dialogue.failure: Don't give up.  Come back when you're ready.

name.str: Clear the dead around the Pokémon Center

description: The dead keep wandering up to the Pokémon Center.  Destroy 25 zombies.

dialogue.offer: The shamblers keep coming to the doors.  The Pokémon are frightened.  Could you thin them out?  Twenty-five should give us some peace.
dialogue.advice: Let your Pokémon fight with you, they'll gain experience too.
dialogue.inquire: How is it going out there?
dialogue.success: It's so much quieter now.  Thank you, truly.
dialogue.success_lie: That doesn't look right to me.
dialogue.failure: Don't give up.  Come back when you're ready.

description: Defeat Team Rocket grunts in Pokémon battles and bring back a copy of their orders.

dialogue.offer: I need to know what Team Rocket is planning.  Their grunts carry orders.  Beat one in a Pokémon battle and bring me the papers.
dialogue.accepted: Good.  They hang around towns, sometimes near Pokémon Centers.
dialogue.advice: Grunts use weak Pokémon: Rattata, Zubat, Ekans, Koffing.  Any decent team can beat them.
dialogue.success: A hideout… and a 'Project M2'.  This is worse than I thought.
dialogue.success_lie: That doesn't look right to me.
dialogue.failure: Don't give up.  Come back when you're ready.

description: Find Team Rocket's hideout beneath the old game corner, defeat their executive, and recover what they stole from Silph Co.

dialogue.offer: The orders point to a hideout under an old game corner.  I've marked it on your map.  Their executive, Archer, runs things there.  Take him down.
dialogue.rejected: I can't do this alone, you know.
dialogue.advice: Take the stairs down.  Expect several grunts.
dialogue.success: You did it!  With Archer beaten, Team Rocket is on the ropes.  But their boss is still out there… Viridian City, you said?
dialogue.success_lie: That doesn't look right to me.
dialogue.failure: Don't give up.  Come back when you're ready.

description: Giovanni, the boss of Team Rocket, is the Viridian City Gym Leader.  Beat him once and for all.  He will not accept a challenge until you hold seven badges.

dialogue.offer: The boss of Team Rocket is Giovanni, the Viridian Gym Leader.  Beat him at his own game and Team Rocket falls apart.
dialogue.advice: He uses Ground-type Pokémon.  Water and Grass moves will serve you well.
dialogue.success: Team Rocket is finished.  The people of Kanto owe you, trainer.  Take this: Silph Co. made it for the police.
dialogue.success_lie: That doesn't look right to me.
dialogue.failure: Don't give up.  Come back when you're ready.

description: The Safari Zone warden wants proof that the rare Pokémon still live here: register Chansey, Kangaskhan and Tauros.

dialogue.describe: A survey of the Safari Zone.
dialogue.offer: I don't know how many of our rare Pokémon survived.  Catch a Chansey, a Kangaskhan and a Tauros for me, and register them in your Pokédex.
dialogue.advice: They're skittish.  Safari Balls work better than normal Poké Balls.
dialogue.success: They made it!  Here, take this, I found it in the brush years ago.
dialogue.success_lie: That doesn't look right to me.
dialogue.failure: Don't give up.  Come back when you're ready.
